fields.name: ShardKey Orleans non-reference field payload
fields.description: The non-reference payload emitted and consumed by ShardKeyOrleansSerializer<...> for every supported ShardKey arity.

members.name: payloadLength
members.description: The ShardKey byte representation's length, written as an Orleans VarUInt32 and read as the count of following payload bytes; no upper bound below the Orleans field limit.

members.name: payload
members.description: The ShardKey ToArray byte representation; the reader consumes the number of bytes specified by payloadLength.

representations.CSharp: writer.WriteVarUInt32((uint)bytes.Length) followed by writer.Write(bytes.Span); reader.ReadVarUInt32() followed by reader.ReadBytes(numBytes).
representations.Orleans: Carried in a field whose wire type is LengthPrefixed when it is not encoded as a reference, framed the same way as Orleans' own length-prefixed codecs.
